question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Contrite
solution:
The correct answer is: **Remorseful**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Contrite **means feeling or expressing remorse or penitence. (पछताया हुआ)

 
 
• **Example**: *After realizing the harm he had caused, he felt contrite and apologized to his friend.*
 
 
 
• Marked option** Remorseful **means a feeling of deep regret, guilt, or sorrow for one's actions or decisions. (ग्लानि से पूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example**: *She was remorseful for lying to her parents about her whereabouts.*
 
 
 
• Synonyms of contrite include remorseful, regretful, apologetic, and penitent.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Persistent **means continuing firmly or obstinately in a course of action in spite of difficulty or opposition. (आग्रही)
 
• **Advertent **means giving attention or heed to a particular subject or fact. (विज्ञापन)
 
• **Renitent **means resisting pressure; obstinate. (दुराग्राही)
